target.profile: HID contacts; Cue Helper MediaProjection native REGION frames; the phone's A2DP mix on the host (BlueALSA) through tools/cue/fnaf4-cues.py; teach panel via LESSON lines; screenrecord 1200x540

question: Night 5 (Fredbear only, AI 12, g228) was played for the first time and died at 38.7 s with the Fredbear branch holding the left door blind. Did the audio carry his side changes, why were they not classified, what were the dark frames after each back, and what killed?
answer: The audio carried four of his landings (R 6 s, L 9 s, R 15 s, R 21 s of level time), every one on the level's 3000 ms grid, at NCC 0.28-0.38 with a 1 s window: under the detector's 0.55 default (and 0.32-0.42 with its 0.6 s window), so none was ever published, the loop held the default left side, and the panel read "He landed left" over a guess. The dark frames after each back are the left door view, open (template doorL at 0.0): the back pressed 1 ms after letting go of the door was dropped both times while the door reopened, and the view detectors matched Night 5 exactly (cal0's templates at 0.0) -- no template problem. The death is the black flash of the hall fuse: nothing but a door hold at the left, and the last landing heard (by replay) was RIGHT at 21 s; 15 one-second counts in the right hall (g644-g646) from the 24 s roll and a 50-frame fuse put the jumpscare at 38.8 s of level time, where the first all-black frame is (38.73 s of night, the level origin 0.52 s earlier).

findings.what: His side sounds reach the A2DP mix ~5 dB under the room (h25/h26 on channel 8 at 45 %, g497; band powers vs the ambience), so a 0.6 s matched filter peaks at 0.32-0.42 and the 0.55 default never publishes one. Every one starts on the 3000 ms grid (g286 rolls; g502/g503 repels; g522/g523 ejects): n5b's four landings sit -52..+25 ms from level tick - 50 ms, and at those instants the two templates separate by 2.9-3.9x. Silence at the other grid instants of the same night scores <= 0.177.
findings.fix: fnaf4-cues.py publishes fb-left/fb-right/laugh from a 1.0 s window at a low floor with a 5-hop publication cap (the hearing model), and the runner accepts only onsets inside +-150 ms of a grid instant at >= 0.23 and 1.5x the other side (fnaf4-fredbear.mjs landings/laughs).

findings.what: The one real-looking laugh sat on the 30 s room tick (h28, 0.50) and was never published live; the live stream's only laugh line (0.639) was off every laugh grid (level 37.7 s; g530 fakes are on 10 s, g639/g640 on 30 s) -- the old LAUGH_MIN 0.62 would have acted on a false match and ignored the real one.
findings.fix: laughs are accepted only on the 10 s grid at >= 0.30; a room-period laugh sends the loop to the bed, then the closet, both SEEN (lit occupancy), before the 10 s fredcheck (g97/g99/g104/g374 -> g558).

findings.what: Actor.holdWhile chained 1000 ms reports with a release between each, on the belief that the game never sees it: the held door read open 0.49, 0.45 and 0.50 s (three times in 17.3 s of holding).
findings.fix: one contact from DOWN to UP (an interruptible transport sleep); a unit test counts the reports.

findings.what: A back pressed 1 ms after letting go of the door was dropped 2 of 2 times (the door still reopening; open reads 361-384 ms after the release), and each time the loop stood 3.0 s at an open door: listening mode, when a roll teleports him to the closet or bed without a sound (g508-g511).
findings.fix: offDoor waits for the open door view before the back; releases are scheduled 50 ms after a tick's sound so the door is shut on the tick.

findings.what: With nothing heard the branch held the LEFT door (fredSide ?? 'L') and the panel titled it "He landed left: holding the left door".
findings.fix: no default: until his first landing the loop waits in a room view (FB_LISTEN) for 4 rolls, then holds guessed doors one tick each, alternating, under FB_GUESS_LEFT/RIGHT; the Companion gains those three steps.

findings.what: Our own carpet run (NCC 0.61-0.85) covered the grid instants at 32.4 s and 35.4 s; a landing there would have been lost.
findings.fix: walks are issued in a quiet slot after a tick (press 225-908 ms, double 75-678 ms after the tick's sound), room ticks skipped.

findings.what: Replayed through the same detector, Nights 1-4 (no Fredbear: AI 0) give 483 side-grid ticks with 6 false LEFT landings on Nights 2-4 (0.233-0.287: h26 resembles Bonnie and Chica's steps h29-h32, 0.19-0.43 template to template) and none on Night 1 (max 0.202); 143 laugh-grid ticks, none within 0.09 of the laugh floor (max 0.211).
findings.fix: side hearing is only used while Fredbear is the only one moving: Night 5, and Nights 6-8 from 4 AM when g599/g601/g603 zero every other AI. That the steps are absent then is a reading of the sheet, not measured on Nights 6-8.

findings.what: Night 5 renders like cal0's Night 1: roomL, doorL, doorL-shut and hub read 0.0; the carpet run reads bed/doorR at 2-8 as on Nights 1-4. The detectors were not the problem.

notMeasured: UNKNOWN(walk-flag): the sheet prints his walk condition as "FlagOn (PARAM68?)" (g491-g496, g508-g511, g526/g527, g639-g642); which flag, and whether the moves consume it, is not printed. R at 15 s and R again at 21 s with no L heard between fits a silent listening teleport at 15 s (we stood at the open left door 12.35-14.97 s) and a bed exit to the right at 21 s (g527), but that is a reading, not a measurement.

UNKNOWN(level-30 laugh): the 30 s tick carries both g530's fake and g639/g640's teleport; a teleport would have reset the hall fuse (g643), so the death at 38.8 s says it was the fake -- not shown directly.
UNKNOWN(grid phase): the onset offset (-50 ms from the breathing-derived level origin) is measured on 4 landings of one run; the origin itself is per-run (first room frame - 520 ms).
UNKNOWN(Fredbear visible): whether the lit bed and lit closet show him against their EMPTY templates (occupancy > 2) has not been seen on this phone; the room check relies on it.
UNKNOWN(closet eject latency): the closet must read shut (follow 33) on a tick for g522/g523; its animation time on the phone is not measured.
NOT MEASURED: a Night 5 with the fixed branch.
